Scimitar / 100 designs

Strongly curved single-edged scimitar, visibly sweeping broad crescent blade which widens toward the outer curved tip, compact quillon crossguard, curved one-hand grip. No enclosed knuckle guard. Keep the deep sweeping curve across all paths.

Each row is one path. T1–T5 describe the visual stage within that path. Click artwork for a larger preview. Thumbnails are embedded when exports are present, so the finished browser travels with the native engine documentation.
